title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Roadmap (investment areas) History
summary: A chronological list of Business Central release waves from 2018 through 2026 wave 1, mapping version numbers (BC14 through BC28) to their corresponding release years and waves. Useful as a reference for understanding the version history and release schedule of Business Central.
key_points: Lists the Business Central releases in reverse order, from 2026 release wave 1 (BC28) back to 2019 release wave 1 (BC14).
There are two release waves each year from 2019 on. Before that come the Fall 2018 release and the Dynamics 365 Tenerife codename.
Some entries are placeholders that the author plans to fill in later, so the history is incomplete.
